description: Turns a re_lookup dossier (lookupId) and/or name, genres, tags and a description into a clean-room rebuild spec that matches the original in function and feel: the systems it is made of, and per system the parameters to measure on the original (speeds, jump arcs, timings, frame data, camera, economy tables, UI layout fractions…) with how to measure them; target engine with conventions (same engine as the original by default); milestones; capture/measure/verify method; clean-room rules (own code, art, audio, text and name). Writes BLUEPRINT.md, parity.json (every parameter with original/rebuild/tolerance) and, for engine targets, a project skeleton with every numeric parameter as a tunable. Archetypes: platformer, shooter, racing, flight, rpg, roguelike, strategy, management, survival, puzzle, card, fighting, sports, narrative, multiplayer, idle, horror, social-app, productivity-app, shopping-app, media-app, fitness-app, web-saas.

description.description: What the original is and does.

engine.description: Engine of the original, if known.

kind.description: game or app (default from the lookup, else game).

name.description: Name of the original (when there is no lookupId).

output.description: Project skeleton folder (new or empty; default workspace/blueprints/<name>/project-<target>).

scaffold.description: Write the project skeleton (default true for engine targets).

target.description: Target: godot, godot-csharp, unity, unreal, threejs, or web, flutter, react-native, swift, kotlin, electron, or a language.

name: re_blueprint
title: Precise rebuild spec for an existing game or app
